description: Read the contents of a single repo-root-confined file, optionally a 1-based inclusive line range (start_line/end_line). The path is resolved (symlinks + '..' collapsed) and MUST be inside the worktree root; traversal, symlink-escape, absolute-outside, and denylisted paths (.git/, profile/ secrets, *.key/*.pem, .env*) are typed-rejected, never clamped or returned empty. Output is byte- and line-capped with an explicit truncated marker plus the true total_lines. If the returned content carries a credential shape (Anthropic/OpenAI key, AWS key, PEM header, bearer token, password=/api_key=), the whole read is REFUSED (Q2) — use search for a redacted view instead.
embedding_description: Read one file's text from the platform repository worktree, optionally a specific line range. Repo-root confined and denylist-guarded; byte/line bounded with a truncation marker. Refuses the whole file if it contains a credential-shaped token. Use to view exact source of a known path.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Object with 'path', 'content' (bounded), 'truncated', 'total_lines' (true count before any cap).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Present the content; if 'truncated' is true, note the byte/line cap fired against total_lines and offer to read a specific range.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reading a repo-root-confined worktree file (optional line range) with byte/line bounding and a secret-shape refusal gate.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: RepoPathError: the path escaped the repo root (traversal / symlink / absolute-outside) or is not a file. RepoDenylistError: the path targets a denylisted location (.git/, profile/ secrets, key material) — excluded, not absent. RepoSecretError: the requested content carries a credential shape and the file is refused whole (Q2).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For RepoPathError: pass a repo-root-relative path to an actual file. For RepoDenylistError: that location is intentionally unreadable; it is excluded by policy. For RepoSecretError: use search (which redacts snippets), or narrow start_line/end_line to a range that excludes the credential.
